description: Pouch.me: a rule-based starting suggestion for bag format and material. It doesn't size the bag or check fit; our team confirms format, size and material on the written quote. Pass answers as {question_id: choice_id} from bag_recommendation_questions.

answers.description: The customer's answers as {question_id: choice_id}, with the ids from bag_recommendation_questions, e.g. {"product": "coffee", "display": "shelf", "priority": "resealable"}. product, display and priority are required; add the material questions to get a material suggestion.
